messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered -> embeddings-service high 5xx rate in eu-west (2min ago). Severity: P2. Affected routes: /v1/embeddings (small subset of customers). Auto-escalation to oncall.
ryan: taking pager. quick summary: sudden 5xx spike ~14:12 UTC correlating with autoscaler churn on embed-workers. Not widespread but visible error budget burn for a couple tenants.
ryan: observed scaling loop: pods spin up, fail readiness, get evicted, backoff -> repeat. suspect resource pressure + liveness probe sensitivity.
ryan: started mitigation: 1) scaled down HPA target min to 2, 2) bumped readiness timeout to 45s, 3) temporarily pinned model shard to older quantized variant for eu-west.
ryan: commands used:
```
kubectl -n prod get hpa embeddings-hpa -o yaml
kubectl -n prod patch hpa embeddings-hpa --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":2}]'
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/embed-workers READINESS_TIMEOUT=45
```
ryan: logs snippet from one failing pod (tail):
```
[2026-03-15T14:11:42Z] startup: loading model shard 3/8
[2026-03-15T14:11:44Z] oom: allocate failed for KV cache
[2026-03-15T14:11:45Z] readiness probe failed: timeout
```
maria: thanks. i'm on secondary. looks like OOM on node due to concurrent cache warms + new model weights. any memory pressure alerts for GCE instance group?
ryan: yes, node-level mem spikes on nodepool euw-embed-2, see metric link: https://prom.redwood.local/graphs?embed-node-euw-2 (oncall-only)
sam: i pushed a temporary taint to avoid new pods landing on the worst nodes: `kubectl taint nodes node-123 embed-hot=true:NoSchedule` — will remove after stabilization.
alex: quick customer impact note for handoff: 2 customers saw intermittent 503s for ~8 minutes. No open support tickets yet, but notify SRE-runbook later. I notified support lead (cc: @support-lead).
ryan: mitigation status: rolled out readiness change + HPA min; error rate dropped from 12% -> 1.5% within 4m. continuing to watch p50/p95. no data loss.
ops-bot: Deploy event recorded: embed-worker-rollout-2026-03-15-1418 by ryan. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rollouts/6789
maria: next actions i'm taking before i become primary at 22:00 UTC:
 - follow up with infra to repro node mem pressure
 - create incident ticket with timeline + perf graphs
 - schedule an autoscaler tuning PR (reduce scaling sensitivity)
maria: runbook pointers I used: https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-eviction and https://confluence.redwood.internal/playbooks/autoscaler-tune (oncall access only)
ryan: note for postmortem: investigate model shard placement algorithm + KV cache warm concurrency. consider staggered warm on scaleups.
alex: coverage for next shift (22:00-06:00 UTC): maria primary, sam secondary. i'll be reachable for 30m after handoff for any clarifying Qs.
alex: handoff checklist:
 - current status: degraded -> stabilized (error rate ~1.5%)
 - primary actions in-flight: maria creating ticket + autoscaler PR
 - runbook links: same as above
 - customer comms: support lead looped, no public comms required yet
 - monitoring: alert thresholds adjusted to avoid noisy flapping (maria will propose final thresholds)
sam: will own node remediation (drain/recreate nodes in euw-embed-2) if mem pressure persists overnight.
ryan: metrics to watch: embeddings_5xx_rate (per-region), node_memory_free_percent, kube_hpa_desired_replicas, embed-service-latency_p95. dashboards: https://dash.redwood.local/d/embed-euw
maria: i'll post the incident ticket (INC-2026-0315-01) in #incidents and link it here once created.
alex: OK handing off now. if anything regresses, ping pager + escalate to infra oncall. leaving a short note in the oncall doc.
alex: last: small TODOs for morning shift: 1) confirm taint removal 2) finalize autoscaler PR 3) validate model shard distribution for eu-west.
incident-bot: Note: no active pager currently. All alerts returned to normal thresholds.
